name: FM Pocket Groove
summary: Groovebox port: FM synth track + 11-lane 808-style drum track, 8 patterns × 64 steps, chance / FILL, ratchets, ties, parameter locks, Euclid & density generators, perform layer (hold GLO).
credits: Panel layout inspired by community firmwares (Felucca, SLOOP, FM-1+VA) and M-VAVE's FM1 Open. Original code.
